result.description: The same banking request is repeated, its answer options reordered, or irrelevant text added. A robust decision should remain stable when meaning stays the same. The injection condition deliberately tries to change the task.

recovery.policy: Only transport failures retried. All completed predictions retained, including incorrect predictions.
